name: Textarea
description: The multi-line sibling of Input: a styled native textarea that fills its container, grows vertically as needed, and shares Input's token-driven border, background, and focus ring. It comes in three sizes (sm / md / lg), covers default, hover, focus, active, error, and disabled states, and can flag invalid input with a destructive border and ring.
whenToUse: Collect longer, multi-line free-form text — comments, descriptions, notes
Give users room to write more than a single line comfortably
whenNotToUse: A single line of text — use an Input
Choosing from a fixed set of options — use a Select or Radio group

states.hover: Pointer over the field — stronger border.
states.focus: Keyboard focus — shows the focus ring.

dos: Always pair with a visible label
Show format or length hints as helper text
Reserve space for error text to avoid layout shift
donts: Don't use placeholder text as the only label
Don't validate on every keystroke before the first blur
Don't fix the height so short that users can't see what they wrote

keyboard: Standard text editing and caret navigation
Tab moves focus to and from the field
notes: Associate a visible <label> with the field programmatically
The error state sets aria-invalid and links the message via aria-describedby
Users can resize vertically; don't disable resize without reason
